facility.name: The Village Early Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 614 S JACKSON ST, ALVIN, TX, 77511

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: The diaper changing table surface was not clean or clear. There were empty styrofoam bowls, and roll of painters tape, and diapers and wipes on the top of the diaper changing table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: Fire inspection is expired as of 5-21-2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: During the monitoring inspection, there was one child file out of ten files viewed that did not have anyone listed for the child to be released to available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not conduted a fire drill since March 24, 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During the monitroing inspection, there were three files out of ten files with no emergency contact other than the parent available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: During the monitroing inspection, there were two files (caregiver and director) did not have transportation training for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: During the monitoring inspection, there was two files out of ten files with no physician information or emergency care facility information available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: During the monitoring inspection, there were six staff files viewed. The following items were missing for review:  Four out of six files were missing Proof of Education  Five out of six Files were missing Form 2985 (Notarized Affidavit)  Two out of six files were missing Signed Copy of Operational Discipline and Guidance Policies  One out of six Files were missing a statement signed and dated by the employee verifying the date the employee attended training during orientation  One out of six files were missing Pre-Employment Affidavit (Form 2912)  Five out of six files were missing Proof of Background Check  Four out of six files were missing Photo I.D
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: Operation people list has not been validated since 3-16-2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: In the PreK classroom, A caregiver did not have a child wash their hands after having their diaper changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Loose-fill surfacing material on the playground is not maintained at the proper depth. There are several spots around the outdoor play space that are bare of loose-fill surfacing material as well as having grass and weeds growing up through the loose-fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning supplies were found in an unlocked cupboard under the sink in the children's bathroom in the PreK classroom. The caregiver moved the cleaning supplies to a shelf in the classroom that was not accessible to children during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation's last sanitation inspection was conducted on 07/17/2025. This is expired as of the 07/31/2025 monitoring inspection. A current sanitation inspection has not yet been conducted but is scheduled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A vehicle battery was found on the floorboard in the first row of child seating in the operation van used to transport children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: Follow Up:   Three files are still  missing the operational  polices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: Follow Up:    Two caregivers still do not have the required trainings in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies: Follow Up:   Three files are still  missing the personal polices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(B))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Follow Up:     One file is still  missing the healthcare provider statement. A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: Three files were missing the center polices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies: Three files were missing the center polices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(B))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There is no documentation that the monthly check were done for the month of July.   A photo was taken of the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: Two caregivers did not have the required trainings in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: A caregiver no longer associated with the operation over 2 weeks had an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There is no documentation that a fire drill was conducted in July. A photo was taken of the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: The school age children were watching a show that was not educational and not related to planned activities for over a hour and 15 minutes. A photo was taken of the television being on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System: The sign in sheets for the week of June 24-28 and July 1-3 could not be located for inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System (26 TAC §746.801(19))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation that the operation has not maintained the toilets and doors and walls were observed with visible dirt on them throughout the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation that supervision is not being maintained. Children were observed in the kitchen and playground area with a caregiver with them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: The handwashing sink area near the boy's restroom did not have any paper towels. This was corrected at inspection when the director put paper towels in the dispenser. A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information obtained during the investigation, sufficient evidence supports a citation for a caregiver who used inappropriate discipline with children in care. The punishment used was the caregiver yelling at the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website: The CPSC form has not been certified in the last twelve months. The last time it was certified was 1/4/2022.    This was corrected when the form was printed off and recertification was done.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website (26 TAC §746.4135(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: On the toddler 3 playground a water hose  was  on ground  were the children have access. A photo was taken. A caregiver wrapped the water hose up and corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Current Driver's License: A caregiver with hire date of 08/05/2010 driver license expired on 05/31/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))
